completed_writebacks.body_anchor: Verification Granularity 也是可调度的计算状态
completed_writebacks.semantic_delta: verification granularity is a schedulable compute state selected from task difficulty, verifier accuracy and budget
completed_writebacks.evidence_boundary: math reasoning experiments and theorem assumptions; production hardware, concurrency and tail latency are not disclosed

completed_writebacks.body_anchor: Preference Pair 选择是实验设计，不只是数据量选择
completed_writebacks.semantic_delta: preference pair acquisition is an experimental design over generation and labeling budgets, not only a dataset-size choice
completed_writebacks.evidence_boundary: theoretical and offline randomized-design assumptions remain explicit

completed_writebacks.body_anchor: Sequential DPO 必须保留目标关系与训练顺序
completed_writebacks.semantic_delta: sequential DPO release review must retain objective relation, order, fixed evaluation reference and pair-level harmed/helped redistribution
completed_writebacks.evidence_boundary: one 8B LoRA model and four preference regimes do not establish a universal forgetting law

completed_writebacks.body_anchor: Policy-implied Value 是 Group Baseline 与 Learned Critic 之间的条件分支
completed_writebacks.semantic_delta: policy-implied value is a conditional branch between group baselines and a learned critic
completed_writebacks.evidence_boundary: fixed reference and coefficient schedules, exact-KL cost and math-only experiments remain limitations

completed_writebacks.body_anchor: Latent Reasoning 要分开路径优化与表示空间约束
completed_writebacks.semantic_delta: latent reasoning has distinct optimization-path and representation-space failures requiring different supervision paths
completed_writebacks.evidence_boundary: tested latent-CoT settings only; not a universal theorem or interpretability guarantee

completed_writebacks.body_anchor: 瞬态视觉证据需要在消失前完成写入决策
completed_writebacks.semantic_delta: transient visual evidence needs a predictive write-before-loss decision owned separately from the action policy
completed_writebacks.evidence_boundary: threshold, annotation and bounded-memory errors remain; no physical safety guarantee

completed_writebacks.body_anchor: Inverse Dynamics 是有前提的 Anti-collapse Regularizer
completed_writebacks.semantic_delta: inverse dynamics is an action-information anti-collapse regularizer with an explicit recoverability precondition
completed_writebacks.evidence_boundary: partial observability, behavior-policy bias and uncontrollable task-relevant state can violate the precondition

completed_writebacks.body_anchor: Learned Security Sensor 与 Reference Monitor 必须分层
completed_writebacks.semantic_delta: within-model causal activation probes and cross-model mapped monitors require separate specificity gates
completed_writebacks.evidence_boundary: small models and one misalignment domain; cross-model intervention is not a transferable safety authority

completed_writebacks.body_anchor: Transparency 不是单一的“可解释程度”
completed_writebacks.semantic_delta: variable transparency, algorithmic transparency and safety monitorability are separate contracts
completed_writebacks.evidence_boundary: opaque serial depth is a bound and the architecture-versus-training cause is unresolved

existing_coverage.body_anchor: Long Context joint contract across position, attention, KV capacity, utilization and SLO
Agent-friendly Tool does not mean wrapping a CLI; interface granularity remains conditional
Full-duplex input turns fusion into online state routing
editable state, sampler commit, block size, correction and caching form a conditional comparison

World-action model already separates explicit future rollout from a direct latent predictive interface and lets the action branch consume layer-wise KV or compact dynamics state without materializing future video
Compression release cannot rely on average perplexity alone, and threshold-adjacent candidates require item-level downstream, calibration and churn evidence
pass@k is bounded sampling coverage and not a proof of distributional impossibility
Typed credit is aligned to the actual state-action boundary while terminal outcome retains reward direction; process signals cannot acquire reward authority
hybrid attention exact-access budget is calibrated by layer and head sensitivity
